statement: Running bookings, stock and payroll in separate tools eats five to ten hours a week that the owner should spend serving customers
segment: Owners of two-to-ten-person service shops (salons, repair shops, studios) in the US
frequency: Weekly, at payroll and stock counts; daily for bookings
cost: Five to ten owner hours a week, plus subscriptions to three or more tools
workarounds: A booking app, a spreadsheet for stock and a payroll service, reconciled by hand
Paper diaries in the smallest shops

evidence.summary: 9 of 12 owners already pay for three or more separate tools for bookings, stock and payroll
Owners described last week's admin in detail: a median of 6 hours reconciling the three tools
Six friends who run no shop said the idea sounds useful

probability.note: Example value; Jev scores it once the scorer runs
